question: For evaporating sodium chlorate droplets at RH of about 59% and 34 C, what share formed single crystals without the magnetic field and with it?
rendered:
According to the excerpt from page 4 of "Evaporative Crystallization of Sodium Chlorate Droplets under Controlled Humidity in the Presence of a Static Magnetic Field":

At RH ≈ 59% and T = 34 °C, the percentage of droplets forming single crystals without a magnetic field (zerofield) is 76.4% (n59 [%] = 58.8) and with a magnetic field of (290 ± 5) mT is 85.7% (n59 [%] = 56.3).
